name: polaris-api-conventions
description: Client guide for the Polaris IP-management and monitoring REST API (/api/v1): bearer tokens bound to roles, error and status conventions, filter-don't-403 NOC feeds, search scopes, device onboarding (create a device, wire its monitoring credentials, enable monitoring), IPAM blocks/networks/reservations, Path Monitor path checks, the SIEM quarantine flow and the events audit tail, generated from the Polaris /api developer page.
